_comments: Sent by the Tasks server (TaskNotificationHandler) to every assignee with a linked user when a task's status becomes Completed. In-app and email on by default; each user can turn either off in Notification Preferences.

fields.Name: Task Completed
fields.Description: Sent to a task's assignees when the task is marked completed.

_comments: Sent by the Tasks overdue scheduled job (OverdueTaskNotificationJob) to the assignees and creator a task's notification config names, once the task is past its due date and grace period, and again as a reminder when the config repeats. In-app and email on by default; each user can turn either off in Notification Preferences.

fields.Name: Task Overdue
fields.Description: Sent when a task is past its due date and not completed or cancelled, and as a repeat reminder when configured.
